_meanings:
.²1 Relating to Aurva.
.²2 Produced from the thigh.
.²3 Relating to the earth.

.²1 <ab>N.</ab> of a celebrated Ṛṣi. [He was a descendant of Bhṛgu, (the son
 of Cyavana by his wife Āruṣī, and grandson of Bhṛgu). The Mahābhārata
 relates that the sons of Kārtavīrya, with the desire of destroying the
 descendants of Bhṛgu, killed even the children in the womb. One of the
 women of the family, in order to preserve her embryo, secreted it in her
 thigh ({%ūru%}), whence the child at its birth was called Aurva. Beholding
 him, the sons of Kārtavirya were struck with blindness, and his wrath
 gave rise to a flame which threatened to consume the whole world, had
 he not, at the desire of his Pitṛs, the Bhārgavas, cast it into the
 ocean, where it remained concealed with the face of a horse; <ab>cf.</ab> Vaḍavāgni.
 Aurva was afterwards preceptor to king Sagara of Ayodhyā]. {#UroryaTOrvasya#}
 {#pfToSca hastAn mAnDAturindrapratimasya mUrDnaH#} <ls>Bu. Ch. 1. 29</ls>.
.²2 Submarine fire; {#tvayi jvalatyOrva ivAmburASO#} <ls>Ś. 3. 3</ls>; <ls>Ve. 3. 7</ls>; so {#˚analaH#}
